queries_run: Booking Holdings AI agents threat online travel agencies disintermediation 2026
Booking Holdings ChatGPT Google Gemini agentic travel booking substitute risk

findings.claim: 2026-09-23 Meta 推出可不經 OTA 直接訂機票/飯店的個人 AI agent，BKNG 當日跌約 5%，Goldman 警告此類 agent 可能衝擊仲介型業務。
findings.source: 247WallSt｜Travel booking stocks tumble as Muse threatens to bypass them
findings.excerpt: Meta's new AI agent can book a flight or hotel room without ever visiting Expedia, Airbnb, or Booking Holdings

findings.claim: 2026-08 報導 OpenAI 縮減 ChatGPT 直接結帳計畫、改以第三方 app 為主；Bernstein 認為降低去中介風險。
findings.source: 搜尋摘要彙整（Bernstein 分析師 Richard Clarke 評論）
findings.excerpt: This means that Booking and Expedia can continue to get in front of consumers on AI-platforms, lowering the risk of disintermediation

findings.claim: BKNG CFO 表示去中介不是真正風險，較實際的風險是損失部分直接流量；2025 直接流量約中 60% 段。
findings.source: Yahoo Finance via newsquantified｜Booking CFO: The AI Threat Isn't 'Really a Risk at All'
findings.excerpt: I don't think disintermediation is really a risk at all.

findings.claim: 2026-02 Marriott、Wyndham 的 agentic 計畫被視為可繞過 OTA；BTIG 認為疑慮過度，因多數飯店為獨立業者。
findings.source: Skift｜Wyndham and Marriott's Agentic Plans Put Pressure on Booking
findings.excerpt: the vast majority of the world's hotels are independents and less able to break away from OTAs.

substitute_technology.note: 3、4 次搜尋未下，節省；excerpt 取自搜尋摘要彙整文字，未讀原頁。
